finalists.label: Langerhans cell histiocytosis
finalists.why: Strong immunohistochemical staining evidence, including positivity for CD33, CD123, CD4, and CD163, and the presence of perivascular and periadnexal infiltrate of cells with homogeneous chromatin and abundant cytoplasm.

finalists.label: Dermatologic disorder
finalists.why: The candidate explains the eruption on the trunk, multiple annular plaques, and scattered café au lait macules, which are specific to the vignette.

finalists.label: Histiocytoid Sweet syndrome
finalists.why: The presence of perivascular and periadnexal infiltrate of cells with homogeneous chromatin and abundant cytoplasm supports this candidate.

frontier_selector.why: The decisive evidence of specific immunohistochemical staining, including positivity for CD33, CD123, CD4, and CD163, and the presence of perivascular and periadnexal infiltrate of cells with homogeneous chromatin and abundant cytoplasm, uniquely supports Langerhans cell histiocytosis.
